name: keyart
prompt: Wide key art for a casual mobile brick-breaker game. A toy world of famous landmarks (an Eiffel-style iron tower, a pyramid, a clock tower, a pagoda) built from chunky rounded clay toy bricks in vivid pink, sky blue, yellow and mint, standing in a row on a dark navy tabletop. Dozens of glossy white balls fly in from below and knock out bricks; brick chunks, cherries, strawberries and gold coins tumble through the air. A friendly cute clay stone-golem boss peeks from behind the tower. Soft matte 3D clay render, gentle studio lighting, soft shadows, rich but not neon colours, no glow, no bloom, no text, no logo. Dark navy night sky background fading to near-black at the edges. Leave the upper-left third calmer for a title.
